assumptions.title_zh: 使用 provisional 边界作为设计输入
assumptions.title_en: Use provisional boundary as design input
assumptions.detail: The site boundary is taken from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson, which is marked geometry_role=provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false, boundary_precision=provisional_rough. The boundary cannot be used as an official redline, approval basis, or precise area basis. Data gap does not block content scoring; after official polygon release, all area metrics and drawings must be recalculated.

assumptions.title_zh: 三处重点区以公告面积和文字四至为依据
assumptions.title_en: Three key areas use announcement area and textual four-boundary description
assumptions.detail: Zhongzhiyuan ~192.1 ha, Beijing AI Origin Community ~104.3 ha, Dazhongsi ~72.0 ha. Provisional polygon shapes are simplified placeholders; layout details await official polygon and tenure data.

assumptions.title_zh: 控规硬指标(容积率/高度/密度)未公开,全部列为待补
assumptions.title_en: Regulatory hard controls (FAR/height/density) not public, all listed as pending
assumptions.detail: The official FAR, building height, building density, green ratio targets, setback, and road redlines are not in the public task package. This proposal does NOT provide specific values for these parameters and does not write speculative values as approved values. After official release, [metric:building_height_m], [metric:floor_area_ratio] and [metric:total_floor_area_sqm] must be recalculated.

assumptions.title_zh: 市政容量与工程方案以概念性表述为主
assumptions.title_en: Municipal capacity and engineering schemes expressed conceptually
assumptions.detail: Specific municipal infrastructure capacity (water supply, drainage, electricity, telecom, integrated corridors) and engineering schemes are not in the public package. This proposal gives conceptual organization only; detailed engineering awaits official data.

assumptions.title_zh: 土地权属资料以公开/简化形式处理
assumptions.title_en: Land tenure handled with public/simplified data
assumptions.detail: Detailed land tenure information is not in the public package. The retain/renovate/build/pending four-tier framework is a logical methodology, not a definitive tenure judgment. The pending tier (~10%) reflects objects whose tenure/regulatory state is unclear.

assumptions.title_zh: 全球案例仅作机制参考,深化阶段需官方或清权来源核验
assumptions.title_en: Global cases as mechanism reference only; deepening phase needs official or cleared sources
assumptions.detail: The six global AI innovation cases (King's Cross, JID Singapore, Station F, Pangyo, Quayside, Shibuya/Marunouchi) are public background references; their specific facts shall be verified with cleared sources during the deepening phase.
